meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein thandi aur dry hawa ki wajah se skin ka moisture jaldi khatam ho jata hai, jisse skin dry aur flaky ho sakti hai.[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/top-body-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-relief-in-winters.html#:~:text=Specifically%20formulated%20for%20sensitive%20skin%2C%20Cetaphil%20Restoraderm,Bright%20Healthy%20Radiance%20Brightening%20Night%20Comfort%20Cream.) Iske liye aapko aise moisturizers chunne chahiye jo **ceramides, hyaluronic acid, shea butter, ya glycerin** se rich hon aur skin barrier ko strong banayein.[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/moisturisers-for-dry-skin-in-winter-8-picks-with-a-4-plus-star-user-rating-on-amazon-101761799374533.html#:~:text=This%20lotion%20is%20perfect%20for%20daily%20use%2C,Moisturizer%20For%20Face%20and%20Body.%20Loading%20Suggestions)

Kuch behtareen aur trusted options ye hain:

Isme **essential ceramides aur hyaluronic acid** hote hain jo skin ki dry barrier ko repair karte hain aur 24 ghante tak moisture lock rakhte hain.[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/moisturisers-for-dry-skin-in-winter-8-picks-with-a-4-plus-star-user-rating-on-amazon-101761799374533.html#:~:text=This%20lotion%20is%20perfect%20for%20daily%20use%2C,Moisturizer%20For%20Face%20and%20Body.%20Loading%20Suggestions)

Yeh cream **sweet almond oil aur niacinamide** se rich hai jo sensitive aur extreme dry skin ko deep hydration deti hai.[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/top-body-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-relief-in-winters.html#:~:text=With%20regular%20use%2C%20Cetaphil%20Optimal%20Hydration%20Daily,skin's%20natural%20barrier%20and%20provides%20long-lasting%20hydration.)

Yeh face moisturizer **5 essential ceramides aur Japanese rice water** ke sath aata hai jo skin ko soft banata hai bina koi heavy ya sticky feel diye.
